newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Jordan's King Hussein meets Irish prime minister.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's King Hussein meets Irish prime minister.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan met Irish Prime Minister John Bruton and Deputy Prime Minister Dick Spring on Wednesday to "discuss political and economic issues", Bruton told reporters after the meeting.
Hussein flew his own plane into Dublin for a 24-hour official visit. Queen Noor, travelling separately, was delayed in London by gale force winds.

Thanking Ireland for its commitment to Middle East peace during its tenure as European Union president, the king said that while there were many areas to explore in times ahead, a lot of danger points had been crossed, he said,
"We will give future generations a chance we never had, a chance of peace and harmony," Hussein said.
The King was greeted at Dublin by Bruton and his daughter Princess Haya, who has been in Ireland for 18 months training as a show jumper and hopes to compete at the Sydney Olympics in 2000.
King Hussein met with President Mary Robinson, shortly after his arrival but had to cancel a tree-planting ceremony due to bad weather.
